# SolStudio LLM Guide

SolStudio has three surfaces:

- `apps/web`: visual Solana program IDE at `solstudio.fun`.
- `packages/cli` plus `apps/standalone`: local visualizer and project CLI.
- `apps/cloud`: Solana workflow automation platform at `cloud.solstudio.fun`.

Use the installed CLI for both local and Cloud work:

```bash
npm install -g @solstudio/cli
```

## Local Project Commands

Use these when the source of truth is a local Anchor, Pinocchio, Quasar, Rust, or IDL project:

```bash
solstudio init .
solstudio parse . --format summary
solstudio audit .
solstudio test .
solstudio doctor .
solstudio view .
```

Local metadata is written to `.solstudio/` inside the project.

## Cloud Commands

Use these when the source of truth is SolStudio Cloud:

```bash
solstudio cloud login --endpoint https://cloud.solstudio.fun --token sst_your_token
solstudio cloud whoami
solstudio cloud status
solstudio cloud nodes list
solstudio cloud workflow list
solstudio cloud workflow create --name "Workflow name" --definition workflow.json
solstudio cloud workflow run <workflow-id> --data payload.json
solstudio cloud execution list --workflow <workflow-id>
solstudio cloud execution get <execution-id>
solstudio cloud credential create --label helius --type helius --set apiKey=...
solstudio cloud wallet list
solstudio cloud wallet create --label ops --network devnet
solstudio cloud profile set selfhost --endpoint https://203.0.113.10 --active
```

Cloud profiles are stored in `~/.solstudio/cloud.json`. Do not put provider keys or wallet secrets into workflow JSON. Store them with `solstudio cloud credential create`.

Workflow JSON shape:

```json
{
  "nodes": [],
  "edges": []
}
```

Discover valid Cloud node types before generating workflow JSON:

```bash
solstudio cloud nodes list
```

## Self-Hosting Cloud

Generate a Cloud-only self-host kit:

```bash
solstudio cloud self-host deploy ./solstudio-cloud --domain cloud.example.com
solstudio cloud self-host check ./solstudio-cloud
solstudio cloud self-host status ./solstudio-cloud
solstudio cloud self-host logs ./solstudio-cloud --tail 100
```

`deploy` writes `docker-compose.yml`, `.env.example`, a generated non-placeholder `.env`, validates required env values, checks Docker, pulls images, starts the Cloud stack, and prints `docker compose ps`.
The default image is `ghcr.io/skartik-sk/solstudio-cloud:latest`; pass `--image` when deploying a custom image from another registry.
Keep a secure backup of `ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY`; losing it makes encrypted Cloud wallets and credentials unrecoverable.

After the self-hosted endpoint is live:

```bash
solstudio cloud login --profile selfhost --endpoint https://cloud.example.com --token sst_your_token
solstudio cloud workflow list --profile selfhost
```

## API Tokens

The Cloud app exposes `POST /api/cli/token` for authenticated browser sessions. It returns a raw `sst_...` token once and stores only a SHA-256 hash in the database. CLI API calls use:

```txt
Authorization: Bearer sst_your_token
```

Primary CLI API base:

```txt
/api/cli/v1
```
